title: Houzz contractor, architect and designer websites
description: Add one or more Houzz professional-directory URLs, discover public company profiles, collect external websites and contacts, and prevent duplicates across runs.

startUrls.title: Houzz directory URLs
startUrls.description: Paste Houzz professional search, category, trade, city or state URLs. Add as many directory URLs as needed.

maximumNewCompanies.title: Maximum new companies this run
maximumNewCompanies.description: Stop after this many new unique company websites are collected.

maximumProfilesVisited.title: Maximum profiles visited this run
maximumProfilesVisited.description: Maximum Houzz professional profiles opened during one run.

maximumListingPagesThisRun.title: Maximum listing pages this run
maximumListingPagesThisRun.description: Maximum Houzz result pages discovered during one run across all supplied URLs.

requireWebsite.title: Require external company website
requireWebsite.description: Output only profiles containing a public website outside Houzz.

collectEmails.title: Collect public profile emails
collectEmails.description: Collect email addresses already displayed publicly on the Houzz profile.

visitCompanyWebsitesForEmails.title: Visit company websites for emails
visitCompanyWebsitesForEmails.description: Optionally open the collected company homepage and extract publicly displayed emails. This makes runs slower.

campaignName.title: Campaign name
campaignName.description: Keep unchanged on continuation runs so queues and duplicate protection are preserved.

resetProgress.title: Reset saved progress
resetProgress.description: Erase this campaign's saved queues and duplicate history before the run.

pageTimeoutSecs.title: Page navigation timeout
pageTimeoutSecs.description: Maximum seconds allowed for loading one listing, profile or company website.

delayMillis.title: Delay between pages
delayMillis.description: Polite waiting time in milliseconds after page navigation.
